candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory calls time out (~2s) in inventory, causing inventory 503s, order ReadTimeouts, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s with p95 ~2425ms.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics or logs admitted; root cause of redis timeouts (saturation, network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and checkout 502; metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 2425ms. Topology confirms inventory->redis path. Bounded to redis-timeout.
